slots.notes: Full-width edge-to-edge looping hero background video pinned to the bottom of the hero and pulled up behind the text (negative -mt-[150px], z-10 under z-20 copy). Rendered w-full / auto height, never cropped (no object-contain or fixed height), with mix-blend-screen so its black background drops out into the page. Played through a native <video> tag driven by a custom hls.js useEffect (NOT react-player); native source is a Cloudflare Stream HLS .m3u8 manifest with an MP4 fallback. Because of mix-blend-screen, supply footage on a true-black background.

Orbit of partner/customer brand logos scrolling forever in the InfiniteSlider logo cloud (OpenAI, Nvidia, GitHub, etc.). Each is a monochrome SVG forced white via brightness-0 invert, so supply flat single-color (currentColor/black) marks on transparency. card:6 is the placeholder set size; the slider tiles however many are provided.

Single 'Zap'-style glyph in the announcement pill, sitting inside a gradient-filled box with a glow. Sourced from lucide-react by default; supply as a currentColor/transparent icon that reads on the purple/pink gradient chip.
Arrow glyph inside the circular badge on the 'Book a 15-min call' CTA button; the circle is filled with the primary purple gradient. Single reused mark; supply as a currentColor/transparent icon.

mechanic: A centered dark glassmorphism hero stacks an announcement pill, a two-line white-to-purple gradient-clipped H1, a muted subheadline and a white pill CTA over a bottom-anchored, mix-blend-screen hls.js background video pulled up behind the text, followed by a glass logo-cloud strip whose motion/react InfiniteSlider scrolls white-inverted partner logos horizontally forever.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS v4 + Vite multi-file component spec (Hero.tsx, App.tsx, components/ui/infinite-slider.tsx), using the hls.js, motion/react, react-use-measure, clsx, tailwind-merge and lucide-react npm packages; native <video> + custom hls.js useEffect drives the Cloudflare Stream HLS background.
reskinNotes: The signature purple/pink gradient is baked inline as Tailwind arbitrary classes (from-[#FA93FA] via-[#C967E8] to-[#983AD6]) reused across the pill icon box, the headline text-clip fill and the CTA arrow circle, so retinting means editing every className string rather than a token. The headline gradient is a background-clip:text fill (white -> purple/pink) hardcoded and tuned for dark backgrounds. The video relies on mix-blend-screen + a baked from-[#010101] via-transparent to-[#010101] overlay and a magic -mt-[150px] overlap offset, so any non-black footage or bg color change breaks the blend, and the responsive 48px->80px headline sizing plus the -150px overlap are tuned to the specific two-line copy. All copy is hardcoded in JSX (eyebrow 'Used by founders. Loved by devs.', headline 'Your Vision' / 'Our Digital Reality.', the subheadline sentence, 'Book a 15-min call', and 'Powering the best teams'). Logo SVGs are remote URLs forced monochrome via brightness-0 invert, so any colored brand logo loses its color; the typeface is only specified as a generic modern sans-serif with no named family.
